stock.description: Fenbi Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of vocational education examination services. It operates through the following segments: Classroom-Based Tutoring Services, Online Tutoring Services, and Sales of Books. The Classroom-Based Tutoring Services segment involves in the offered by the Group through classroom teaching to the students who physically attend the lectures in tutoring centers and tutoring bases and campuses. The Online Tutoring Services segment includes all the tutoring services except for the Classroom-based tutoring services, and mainly represent online tutoring services, membership package, and challenge exercise. The Sales of Books provides tutoring services and printing business relevant with book selling business. The company was founded by Xiao Long Zhang and Li Ang Wei in 2015 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
